Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game. South Africa have been dealt a knockout blow in their chance of making it to the semi-finals. However, don't go anywhere as the virtual knockout between Pakistan and Bangladesh is set to begin at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT). You can switch tabs to catch all the updates. Cheers!

Scott Edwards, the victorious skipper of Netherlands is up for a chat. He says he is lost for words. Adds they are quite use to such conditions in Netherlands and credits the boys for the way they played. He is pleased they managed to end the tournament on a high and secured qualification for the next World Cup.

Temba Bavuma, the captain of South Africa is up for a chat. He says they are disappointed, they were playing well till now and it was a game they should have won but it is a tough one to swallow. Adds they were just under par and they once again kept losing wickets at wrong times and it is going to be a tough one to swallow.

Colin Ackermann is the player of the match for his brillian knock. He says that it is a fantastic feeling and they deserved this victory. Adds that they have worked really hard for this. Mentions that the pitch was slow and there was a bit of turn, but the plan was to take the game deep and luckily the boundaries flowed at the end.
Presentation time...
Earlier in the day, Netherlands got themselves to a competitive total thanks to some handy contributions from the top order. They though did brilliantly with the ball to defend that.

South Africa, just did not have that one batter who would help them get over the line. They needed someone to go on and plan an innings of significance but that did not happen. A few of them got off to starts but none went on to make use of it. In the end, they were reliant on David Miller and Heinrich Klaasen to finish it but the two failed to do so too.

The key for the Dutch was wickets at regular intervals. Whenever, they were pushed onto the back foot, they managed to strike. All their bowlers bowled with excellent control. Fred Klaassen was brilliant but it was Glover's two overs and the spell from Bas de Leede which won them the game. However, credit to all their bowlers and the fielders who were absolutely brilliant.

What a win, what a win that is for Netherlands. Not only them and their fans but the whole of Pakistan and Bangladesh will be celebrating along with them.  The two now have a chance to make it through to the semis out of nowhere. The South African fans are in disbelief. They were overwhelming favourites heading into this encounter but have come out second best. The Dutch have overcome the odds and have knocked South Africa out of the tournament. They have actually played as party spoilers. Unbelievable!

FOUR! A boundary to end the innings but that will not be enough for South Africa. This is on a hard length and outside off, Anrich Nortje cuts it wide of deep point for a boundary. NETHERLANDS WIN BY 13 RUNS.

OUT! TAKEN! Keshav Maharaj goes back to the hut now. Bas de Leede bowls this short of a length and outside off, Keshav Maharaj punches it uppishly towards deep point where Max O'Dowd takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Max O'Dowd b Bas de Leede

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one and on off, Kagiso Rabada drives it towards sweeper cover for one. It is all but over South Africa now.
This is pitched up, on off, Kagiso Rabada drills it towards cover. No run. 19 runs from 3 balls now.
This is full and on off, Kagiso Rabada slaps it wide of long off where the fielder dives to his left to stop it. Two runs taken.
Bas de Leede bowls a high full toss, on off, Kagiso Rabada smashes it towards long on for a brace. It is called a no ball. Free hit coming up..
This is full and outside off, way outside off, Kagiso Rabada leaves it alone. It is called wide.

Dropped! This is full and on middle, Keshav Maharaj goes for the heave, but hits it with the bottom of the bat. It flies in the air towards deep mid-wicket where Logan van Beek spills it out. A single is taken.
Bas de Leede to bowl the last over.
Full and on off, Keshav Maharaj lofts it with no timing at all towards long on for a single. South Africa need 26 runs in 6 balls.
Logan van Beek bowls a good length delivery, on the leg stump line, Keshav Maharaj moves across to flick it away but misses.
SIX! Bang! Over the fence! They need a lot more. On middle, this is whacked over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Fuller and on off, it is hit down to long off for one.
Shorter and on middle, it is hit through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is hit down to deep mid-wicket for one.
Singles won't do it. On off, it is hit towards mid off for one.
Another one as this is hit down to long on.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Who will walk out now?

OUT! TAKEN! IS THAT THE FINAL NAIL IN THE COFFIN? The last recognized batter, Klaasen falls. This is short and on the body. Klaasen looks to pull but it goes off the splice towsrew deep mid-wicket and it is taken by the fielder in the deep. The bowling all-rounders now need to do it for South Africa. They need a miracle.
Commentary.Howout: c Logan van Beek b Bas de Leede

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, Maharaj slashes but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two dots in a row and that is another top over for Netherlands. Outside off again, Maharaj looks to cut but misses.
Dots are gold! Short and outside off. Maharaj slashes but misses.
Singles won't harm Netherlands. On off, this is guided through point for one.
A dot now! Outside off, this us pushed to cover.
Only one again! Fuller and outside off, Maharaj pushes it through covers for one only.
Just the one. Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Just the one again! On middle. This is clipped through mid-wicket for one. Klaasen retains strike but that is a magical over from Glover.
Fuller and outside off, this is pushed through covers foe one.
Keshav Maharaj walks out to bat now.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Another one bites the dust. South Africa in huge trouble now. This is full and outside off, Parnell throws his bat at it, it goes off the outside edge and it is taken by Scott Edwards behind the stumps. A lot now depends on Heinrich Klaasen.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Brandon Glover

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Down the leg side. Parnell looks to flick but misses. Wide.
Shorter and outside off, Parnell slashes but misses.
Wayne Parnell is the next batter in for South Africa.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a stunning catch. Is that the catch which knocks South Africa out? Miller. The finisher for them walks back and Netherlands will feel they are on top of the game. This is short and on the body. Miller looks to pull but it goes off the top edge over short fine leg. Roelof van der Merwe runs back and takes it brilliantly. Never easy when it is Iverson your should like that. Do South Africa have another hero here?
Commentary.Howout: c Roelof van der Merwe b Brandon Glover

Full again and on middle, Heinrich Klaasen eases it towards long on for one. South Africa need 48 runs off 30 balls now.

Back of a length and on off, Heinrich Klaasen dabs it towards point.

On a length and on off, David Miller gudies it straight to point.

OUT! TAKEN! Fred Klaassen gets a huge wicket, and the game turns around again. A soft dismissal, but Aiden Markram has to go back to the hut. It goes off the leading edge towards short cover where Stephan Myburgh takes a fine catch diving to his right.

Full and on leg, David Miller tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Fred Klaassen (3-0-14-1) comes back into the attack.

Short and on middle, Aiden Markram mistimes his pull shot towards fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Powered away! This is looped up, full and on middle, Aiden Markram smashes it past the bowler for a boundary.

Tossed up, full and on off, David Miller drives it back towards the bowler who makes a half-stop.
Length again, on leg, David Miller tucks it towards square leg for one.

On a length and on off, Aiden Markram steers it towards deep point for one.

Dropped! A tough chance, but should have been taken. This is on a hard length and on off, David Miller slices it uppishly towards point where Stephan Myburgh dives to his left but cannot hold on. A single is takne.
On a length and around off, David Miller guides it towards third man and calls for two, the fielder throws at the keeper's end, but Miller dives in to make it.
Logan van Beek starts with a good-length delivery, on middle, Aiden Markram pushes it towards long on for a single.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket foe one.
Angled into the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.

Drinks! Netherlands get the big wicket of Rilee Rossouw and this game hangs in the balance at the moment. South Africa have two new batters at the crease and they need to build a partnership. Netherlands will look to get a couple of wickets more and put pressure on the batters. A very important session for both teams awaits as a lot is at stake. Also, David Miller walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Just as the game was slipping away, Netherlands strike. The centurion for South Africa in this World Cup walks back. Shorter and on middle, Rilee looks to pull, no timing on it, it goes off the splice towards deep square leg where Max O'Dowd settles under it and takes a nice catch. Game hangs in the balance now.
Commentary.Howout: c Max O'Dowd b Brandon Glover
